Dental Exam Gloves

Safco Dental Supply offers a wide range of high-quality dental exam gloves designed for superior comfort, protection, and tactile sensitivity. Perfect for patient exams, surgical procedures, or utility tasks, our collection of gloves provide reliable barrier protection and ergonomic performance to keep your team safe and efficient.

Complete protection – A full selection of dental gloves to ensure safety and compliance across all clinical procedures.

Comfort and performance – Gloves engineered for exceptional fit, flexibility, and sensitivity to enhance control and reduce fatigue.

Material options – Available in nitrile, latex, vinyl, or chloroprene to match your preference for comfort, durability, and allergy safety.

Hygiene & compliance – Consistent quality and dependable protection to meet the highest infection-control standards in every operatory.

Safco’s Dental Exam Gloves Product Range

Our dental exam gloves category offers protective gloves and accessories for every dental procedure, from everyday exams to specialized surgical work.

  • Chloroprene Gloves – Combine the elasticity of latex with the strength and comfort of nitrile.


  • Glove Holder – Keeps gloves organized and accessible for efficient operatory workflow.


  • Latex Gloves – Offers natural flexibility and excellent tactile feel for precise handling.


  • Nitrile Gloves – Durable, puncture-resistant, and latex-free for maximum protection and allergy safety.


  • Surgical Gloves – Sterile gloves designed for aseptic technique and superior control during surgery.


  • Vinyl Gloves – Cost-effective and comfortable for short procedures or non-critical applications.

What Are Dental Exam Gloves?

Dental exam gloves are single-use protective barriers worn by dental professionals to prevent cross-contamination and maintain infection control during clinical and surgical procedures. Available in nitrile, latex, vinyl, and chloroprene, these gloves balance strength, sensitivity, and comfort.

Modern glove technologies enhance tactile precision while reducing hand fatigue, so clinicians can work confidently throughout the day.

Why Quality Dental Exam Gloves Matter

High-quality dental gloves protect both patients and practitioners while supporting efficiency and comfort. Properly fitting gloves improve dexterity and reduce hand strain, while premium materials provide reliable protection against contaminants and chemicals.

Safco Dental Supply offers trusted gloves from leading manufacturers, ensuring your practice maintains the highest standards of safety, comfort, and clinical performance.
